Welcome to Life University! Here you’ll find videos that bring our campus to life, from student stories and classroom experiences to chiropractic innovation, wellness, and community impact.

At Life U, we’re committed to excellence in teaching, learning, and research. Our programs empower students with the education, skills, and values to reach their highest potential and live with Integrity and Lasting Purpose.

Located in Marietta, Georgia, Life University is home to the world’s largest single-campus chiropractic program and a thriving community of learners dedicated to transforming health and society through a vitalistic philosophy.
